asserts: The local stack gives an S2S key to exactly the stack services packages/contracts lists as signing services, so no service boots unkeyed and none gets a key it has no use for.
why: Imports SERVICE_NAMES from packages/contracts' service-keys module (tsx runs the source, no build) and compares it with S2S_SERVICES and the stack's services.

asserts: Every /api/<module> upstream svc-edge routes to, and every module the Customer app calls, is a service the local stack starts or one it lists absent with a reason.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/local-test-stack.test.mjs#Every Edge upstream, and every module the Customer app calls

why: Imports svc-edge's exported UPSTREAMS table and checks each prefix and env var against the stack's plan; the same 22 rows the text read found.

asserts: A Customer call to /api/edge is exempt from the upstream check only while svc-edge itself serves the rate-limit doors.

guard.ref: services/svc-edge/src/wire-replay.test.ts#every request in the matrix gets the recorded status, headers and body

why: Reads svc-edge's wire-replay record of the routes its booted entrypoint registers (routes.json, held equal to the process by wire-replay.test.ts) and exempts edge only when both door routes are in it.

asserts: A reach record claims bus delivery lines only when the bus both exports the event name and calls announceDelivered in its pump.
why: busLogs is run on planted bus files (both parts, the call removed, the export missing) instead of a mutated copy of the real source; busLogs(REPO) still holds the real checkout to true.

asserts: Convert prices a firm quote against a market's book over its base and quote assets, so stocking both sides of each default market is what convert needs.

guard.ref: services/svc-trade/src/convert/quote.test.ts#presents source, expiry, and exact in/out decimal strings

why: That test calls presentConvertQuote and asserts source kind 'book' and in/out assets from the market's quote and base, and FirmConvertQuote (quote.ts) requires baseAsset, quoteAsset and a 'book' source by type; only the read and its three matches were removed by hand, since the same test block also holds the house-inventory property.

asserts: The no-unsealed-claim lint rule holds the same words and the same owner seal as the marketing-language law module.

guard.ref: tooling/lint/oxlint-plugin-garden/index.test.mjs#the words and the seal are the law module

why: Imports the law module, compares MARKETING_BAN_WORDS with CLAIM_WORDS and the seal marker, and checks the rule and the law return the same words on sealed, honest and claiming lines.

asserts: Replaying past route changes, the published-routes gate leaves the generated file and the route words as the checkout holds them.
why: The read is the generator's output in a scratch checkout, compared with this checkout's generated file; the gate under test writes that file from svc-trade's registrations.

asserts: The gate's replay of past route changes ends with the route words file unchanged, and the words a change adds are all it needs.
why: The reads are the gate's fixture input in a scratch checkout (edited to replay history) and its compare against this checkout's copy; the gate itself reads that file as text (wordsProblems), so the fixture can only be text.

asserts: The published route list (served-routes.generated.ts) equals what svc-trade registers, with the access and scopes each registration declares.
why: A generated file compared with its generator: svc-trade's sources are the generator's input, parsed by svc-trade's own route-declarations harness, the same parser tooling/ci/published-routes.mjs runs.
